title: Mega Agency Pivots & Leadership Changes
shortDesc: The global marketing industry is seeing major shifts as brands rethink their agency partnerships and leadership structures.
fullContent:
PepsiCo Moves to Publicis: PepsiCo has moved its global media account from Omnicom to Publicis Groupe in one of the year's biggest agency changes. The shift reflects the growing focus on integrated media, data, technology, and AI capabilities.

Marketing Leadership Consolidates: Major brands are also combining marketing and digital functions to create more unified customer strategies. Kohl's, for example, has brought its marketing and digital operations together under a Chief Customer Officer structure.

The changes highlight a wider industry trend: brands are increasingly connecting media, digital, data, AI, and customer experience under fewer, more integrated teams.
